context: Two siblings playfully argue about whose turn it is
purpose: Teach: 仲良く/限っ/接触/伺っ/問う/ラッキー/もったいない/言い訳

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ちょっと、今日に限って何で先にお風呂入ろうとしてるの？私が先って言ったよね。
lines.en: Hey, why are you trying to go in the bath first today of all days? I said I was going first, right?
lines.style: Teen sister, assertive but playful, slightly whiny tone

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: えー、昨日も姉ちゃんが先だったじゃん。言い訳しないでよ、こっちの番だって。
lines.en: What? You went first yesterday too. Don't make excuses, it's my turn.
lines.style: Teen brother, exasperated, casual masculine speech turning the tables

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: は？言い訳してないし。先生に伺ったみたいな丁寧な口調で言われてもさ、無理なものは無理。
lines.en: Huh? I'm not making excuses. Even if you talk all polite like you asked a teacher, no means no.
lines.style: Teen sister, sarcastic mocking tone, dismissive comeback

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: じゃあお母さんに問うてみる？どっちが先か、ちゃんと答えてくれると思うけど。
lines.en: Then should we ask Mom? She'll give us a proper answer about who goes first.
lines.style: Teen brother, smug counter-threat, escalating the standoff

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うわ、すぐ親頼みかよ。兄弟なんだから仲良くジャンケンで決めようよ、ね？
lines.en: Wow, running to the parents already? We're siblings, let's settle it nicely with rock-paper-scissors, okay?
lines.style: Teen sister, mock-offended pivot, sly proposal with raised stakes

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: いいよ、受けて立つ。負けた方が皿洗いも追加な、その条件で。
lines.en: Fine, I'll take you on. Loser also does extra dishes, on those terms.
lines.style: Teen brother, accepting challenge, confident gambler tone

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ほら、私の勝ち！ラッキー！このチャンス逃したらもったいないから速攻で入るね。
lines.en: See, I won! Lucky! It'd be a waste to miss this chance, so I'm jumping in right away.
lines.style: Teen sister, victorious gloating, bouncy celebratory energy

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うそだろ…手の接触のタイミングで絶対後出しただろ、姉ちゃん絶対ずるしたって。
lines.en: No way... You totally went late when our hands met, sis definitely cheated.
lines.style: Teen brother, defeated grumbling, accusing under breath bitterly
